title.narrative: PROBIO - Protecting biodiversity through law enforcement and community-led initiatives

description.narrative:
The overall objective (impact) of the proposed action is to achieve improved protection of Liberia¿s biodiversity through community-led conservation and law enforcement networks. The outcomes (specific objectives) leading to the overall objective are the following:

Outcome 1: Improve conservation of (proposed) protected areas in Liberia

Outcome 2: Improve fight against Illegal Wildlife Trade in Liberia

Outcome 3: Increase awareness on conservation, biodiversity protection and sustainable use of natural resources
